pages.title: Using the Altar
pages.text: Mountains may separate you, but a recall altar can guide your companion home.$(br2)Place it and right-click. Choose a dragon, check the cost, then confirm. Leave clear ground nearby for its arrival.

pages.title: Crafting the Altar
pages.text: Use any mix of fire, ice and lightning dragonforge bricks. The altar works as soon as it is placed.

pages.title: The Dragon Roster
pages.text: The roster remembers your dragons once encountered: healthy, severely injured or petrified, in either form. They keep their names, growth, knowledge and belongings.$(br2)Permanently executed dragons no longer appear.

pages.title: Recovering Your Dragon
pages.text: A recorded companion can return even if its horn is lost. Old horns and statues cannot release the same dragon again.$(br2)Carry an older horn briefly to register the companion inside.

pages.title: Arrival and Costs
pages.text: Homecoming preserves injury or petrification. Feed meat to the injured, or use a $(l:care/petrification_remedy)Petrification Remedy$(/l) on stone. Hunger returns to 50.$(br2)Nearby recalls are free. Longer or cross-dimension trips cost your experience; check the quote first.
